lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 25 -- Have You Ever...?
lesson.grammar_point: present perfect for life experience (have you ever / I have / I have never)

listenings.text: Hi everybody, it's Claire. Welcome to our new director in Shanghai, Mr. Li. Mr. Li has worked in supply chain for fifteen years. He has worked in China, Germany and Mexico, and he has managed four new plants. He has never lived in Europe, so if you see him in Paris, please say hello! Have a great week.

Hi Rodrigo, Tom here. A question for your visit. Have you ever been to a baseball game? If not, we have tickets for a Yankees game on Saturday. I've been to many games, and it's a great experience. And have you ever eaten a New York hot dog? It's part of the game! Let me know.

extra_audio.text: Rodrigo started his career in a small factory. Then he worked in planning and in purchasing. He has managed three product launches. He has visited the plants in France many times. Now he is the Operations Director at Robertet Brazil.
